name: Dutch & Dutch 8C
author: Ric
description: Dutch & Dutch 8c/6c room in the bar: gain, mute, standby, input select (AES3/analog/File Player), presets, RoomMatching profiles, tone controls, front LED, and device status. Keyboard-first panel; backed by the bundled dd8c CLI (local WebSocket mesh API, no cloud).

barWidget.description: Control the Dutch & Dutch room: click for the panel, middle-click mute, scroll to change volume.

schema.label: Master speaker IP
schema.description: Master 8c address (find it with: bin/dd8c discover). Empty = mDNS discovery at startup.
